purpose: Teach: 角栄/野茂/バチカン/アーセナル/レオナルド/コスタリカ/苫小牧/クウェート

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、社会で田中角栄習ったろ?
lines.en: Riku, you learned about Kakuei Tanaka in social studies, right?
lines.style: Playful accusation, testing him. Quick rhythm, eyes narrowing slightly. She's setting a trap and enjoying it. Leans forward just a bit.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、野茂英雄の伝記読んでたな、桜
lines.en: You were reading that Hideo Nomo biography, weren't you, Sakura?
lines.style: Calm turnabout. He flips it back at her without rushing, almost amused. Eyes steady, slight uptick at the end—got you. Not defensive, just fair.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、宗教でバチカン習ったろ?
lines.en: Riku, you studied the Vatican in religion class, didn't you?
lines.style: Same playful momentum, building the pattern. Faster rhythm now, confidence rising. She's enjoying this game and doesn't hide it. Bright attack on each question.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、アーセナルのファンだったな、桜
lines.en: You were an Arsenal fan, weren't you, Sakura?
lines.style: He matches her pace now. Quicker delivery than before, catching up to her energy. Small hint of a smile in the voice—he's figured out what she's doing and he's playing along.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、美術でレオナルド・ダ・ヴィンチ習ったろ?
lines.en: Riku, you studied Leonardo da Vinci in art class, right?
lines.style: The rhythm accelerates again. She's almost breathless with excitement now, firing the questions faster. Knows he's catching on but doesn't care—the game is working. Sharp, quick hits.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、社会でコスタリカ習ったろ?桜
lines.en: You studied Costa Rica in social studies, didn't you, Sakura?
lines.style: Faster still. He's matching her acceleration without strain. Voice stays light, eyes bright. There's a rhythm between them now—they're dancing. Still warm underneath.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、修学旅行で苫小牧行ったろ?
lines.en: Riku, you went to Tomakomai on your school trip, didn't you?
lines.style: Peak rhythm. Rapid-fire delivery, barely a breath between thought and speech. She's almost laughing between words. Triumphant and giddy all at once.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、社会でクウェート侵攻習ったろ?桜
lines.en: You learned about the invasion of Kuwait in social studies, didn't you, Sakura?
lines.style: He's caught up completely now. Rapid, breathless finish matching hers. Voice warm and bright—he's right there with her. The accusation lands like a high-five.
